'''Thexan's lightsaber''' was a [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] wielded by [[Thexan]], son of [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] and a Prince of [[Zakuul]].

==History==
[[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] twin sons [[Arcann]] and [[Thexan]] were both trained in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] from an early age. As part of their training, the boys have constructed their first lightsaber while still in childhood. By the time they came of age however, both brothers had other lightsabers, identical in appearance and bearing Zakuulan ornamental motifs.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

[[File:Arcann_kills_Thexan.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Thexan's brief duel with his brother ends in his death.]]
Thexan wielded this lightsaber during the [[Eternal Empire raids]], against foes from both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Upon their return to [[Zakuul]], Arcann and Thexan presented trophies of the slain foes to their father, only for Valkorion to turn away in silence. Furious, Arcann attack their father, but Thexan [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] pulled him back. The twins exchanged a few blows, but their brief duel ended when Arcann struck his brother down with a cut across the stomach. These injuries proved fatal to Thexan.<ref name="Sacrifice" />
